editorial:
You get thrown into Bryan Mills’s worst nightmare when his ex-wife is killed and he is framed for the crime. Instead of giving up, he uses his old spy skills to stay one step ahead of the police and hunt down the real killer. Liam Neeson brings his usual tough, calm energy, while Forest Whitaker’s inspector adds a smart cat-and-mouse feel. His daughter Kim is caught in the middle, which raises the stakes and keeps the story personal.

The action moves fast, with car chases, fights, and close calls that keep you watching. It is not as fresh as the first film, and some twists feel easy to guess, but the finale is loud and satisfying. If you enjoy no-nonsense thrillers with a strong lead, this is a solid pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: Bryan discovers that his ex-wife’s new husband, Stuart, helped set him up, while the real killer is tied to a Russian mobster named Oleg Malankov. Bryan tracks Malankov down, fights him, and kills him. Stuart is exposed and arrested after trying to escape. Bryan clears his name, reunites with Kim, and the police back off. The final scenes show him safe with his family, ready for whatever comes next.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action thrillers and Liam Neeson movies.
